prompts.background: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE high-resolution photographic landscape, wide 3:2 canvas matching a 1920x1248 desktop scene composition. Calm first-person human eye level, fixed natural 35mm lens, level horizon. Soft natural illumination, realistic texture, moderate contrast and saturation, no HDR, no fantasy glow. A continuous believable space with a clearly visible route from bottom center toward a stopping place near x=50%, y=48%. This is a BACKGROUND PLATE for later multi-plane FFmpeg camera parallax: keep the central view open, do not include large close framing objects at the edges since these are separate layers. The image must fill every edge with scenery. No people, bodies, animals, signs, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. Open grassy prairie with gentle rolling hills and an unobstructed distant horizon, scattered low wildflowers, soft sage and fresh green grasses, pale blue sky, a little morning haze, softly warm light from upper LEFT. A discreet grass path opens at bottom center and leads into the open meadow, stopping on gentle flat terrain. The space feels wide and unconfined; no dense forest, no mountains dominating, no fences, no large near grass framing the sides.
prompts.middle: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY the lighting, texture, palette and eye-level perspective reference. Generate ONE independent middle-near parallax layer on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Full wide 3:2 landscape canvas aligned with reference. Draw ONLY two loose irregular clusters of prairie grasses and tiny white/yellow wildflowers at the outer LEFT 18% and RIGHT 16%, growing from beyond bottom edge, reaching up only into bottom 35% of image. Realistic delicate leaves and stems, partly backlit by upper-left morning light, no ground carpet; center and upper two-thirds transparent. Match the reference with soft sunlight from upper LEFT, natural material detail and moderate contrast. Preserve CENTRAL 60% of width as completely transparent from top to bottom for an open pathway. No backdrop, no ground plane, no solid-color background, no fake checkerboard, no vignette; every pixel except actual objects is transparent. No people, animals, text, logo, watermark or collage. One cutout plate ready to composite over the reference, not a rendering of a finished combined scene.
prompts.near: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY a lighting, color and photographic texture reference. Generate ONE closest foreground layer with actual RGBA alpha transparency, wide 3:2 full canvas. Draw ONLY a few close soft grass blades and two or three delicate small meadow wildflowers, emerging from beyond the bottom outer corners. Only lower 23% and outer 18% each side, subtle depth-of-field softness, no lawn or turf slab. Lighting matches reference: warm soft morning light from upper LEFT and natural gentle shadows. Everything above the lower corner foliage and the central 60% corridor must be completely transparent, not a blurry backdrop. Fine natural edges, no ground plane, no filled background, no solid color, no painted checkerboard, no vignette, no whole scene, no collage. No person, animal, text or watermark. Match the realism of the reference and keep the near plants modest so that they will slide outward as the viewpoint moves forward.
